evidenceKind: FFDec static tags; no original-runtime playback authority

clockContract.epoch: Each explicit character placement starts a structural placement epoch, including same-character replacement; move-only tags retain the epoch. Removal ends it.
clockContract.localFrameCandidate: If an independent child advances once per parent frame and loops at its declared frame count, frame = 1 + ((parentFrame - entryFrame) mod localFrameCount). This is a query model only.
clockContract.ratio: Source ratio fields are retained literally. A ratio on a sprite placement is not by itself evidence of morph interpolation.
clockContract.unresolved: Original-runtime child advancement, loop, restart on explicit same-character replacement, stop behavior, parent seek, and one-frame sprite-258 visibility are unverified. Do not claim parity from this IR.
